Name: Achievement Checklist
Author: TetsuRemo
Description:
[size=5][b]Achievement Checklist / 成就明细追踪[/b][/size]

[b]点击展开中文说明[/b]
[spoiler]
[b]成就明细追踪[/b]

想知道“混合栽培”还差哪种作物？或是“大师级烹饪”漏了哪道菜？本 Mod 提供了一个简洁的分类界面，实时追踪所有收集类成就的具体进度。

[b]主要功能：[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]明细追踪[/b]：详细列出混合栽培、单一栽培、全出货、烹饪、钓鱼、制作以及博物馆捐赠所缺失的物品。[/*]
[*][b]内置界面[/b]：支持自定义快捷键（默认 [b]F7[/b]），随时在游戏内开启成就清单菜单。[/*]
[*][b]高度兼容[/b]：支持 [i]Generic Mod Config Menu[/i] 调整快捷键。[/*]
[/list]
[b]安装要求：[/b]
[list]
[*] SMAPI 4.0.0 或更高版本[/*]
[*]星露谷物语 1.6 或更高版本[/*]
[/list][/spoiler]
----------------------------------------------------------------


[b]English Description [/b]
Ever wondered which crop you're missing for the "Polyculture" achievement? Or which dish you haven't cooked for "Master Chef"? This mod provides a clean, categorized UI to track every item needed for collection-based achievements.

[b]Key Features:[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Detailed Tracking:[/b] Shows exactly which items are missing for Polyculture, Monoculture, Full Shipment, Cooking, Fishing, Crafting, and Museum donations.[/*]
[*][b]In-Game UI:[/b] Press a customizable hotkey (default: [b]F7[/b]) to toggle the achievement checklist menu.[/*]
[*][b]Configurable:[/b] Supports [i]Generic Mod Config Menu[/i] for easy keybinding.[/*]
[/list]
[b]Requirements:[/b]
[list]
[*] SMAPI 4.0.0+[/*]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6+[/*]
[/list]
[line]
[i]Developed by TetsuRemo. Feel free to report bugs on the posts tab![/i]
